EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a para-disubstituted benzene fingerprint: strong aromatic C–H out-of-plane bands at ~811–825 cm⁻¹, a prominent ring mode near 1206 cm⁻¹, and an aromatic C=C band at 1621 cm⁻¹. The C–H stretching region has both aromatic (3022, 3057 cm⁻¹) and aliphatic (2879, 2932, 2972 cm⁻¹) bands, and CH₃ deformation bands at 1450 and 1382 cm⁻¹, all consistent with a dialkylbenzene. Absence of an O–H stretch disfavors candidates with OH or strong C–O features (e.g., 8, 10). Candidate 1 (p-ethyltoluene) best matches this pattern of para-dialkylbenzene Raman features.
